segments.text: Set up your OpenFOAM simulation environment with Podman and Eddy3D in just a few steps.
First, download and install Podman Desktop, a free and open-source tool for managing containers.
Complete the Podman setup and make sure the Podman machine is running. This provides the environment needed to execute OpenFOAM containers.
Now open Rhino and Grasshopper. In Eddy3D, launch the engine setup interface.
Eddy3D already provides the OpenFOAM container image through its installation interface. Simply pull the image, and Eddy3D handles the setup through Podman.
Once the image has been downloaded and verified, your OpenFOAM environment is ready for simulations through Eddy3D.
You're all set. Start exploring computational fluid dynamics with Eddy3D.
